trigger_condition: Operator writes `authorizationServer: []` -- an empty list validates and is served
potential_consequence: Client sees key present but no issuer; discovery mode entered with nothing to discover

trigger_condition: Any element that is not an https URL: `auth.example.com`, `http://...`, whitespace, empty string
guard_snippet: authorization_server: Optional[List[AnyHttpUrl]] = ... plus a validator rejecting non-https schemes
potential_consequence: Client fetches issuer metadata from an unusable or attacker-chosen origin; OAuth flow subverted or broken

trigger_condition: Issuer written non-canonically: trailing slash, default port, uppercase host, extra path segment
guard_snippet: @field_validator('authorization_server') -> reject values with a trailing '/' or query/fragment
potential_consequence: Published issuer mismatches the token `iss` claim; client rejects every token post-deploy

trigger_condition: List carries two or more issuers; no rule selects which one the client uses
guard_snippet: max_length=1 on the field, or document and pin the selection rule (first entry wins)
potential_consequence: Client picks an unintended issuer or errors; behavior differs silently per client version

trigger_condition: Issuer unrelated to tokenUrl/authorizationUrl origin; no cross-field consistency check exists
guard_snippet: @model_validator(mode='after') warn/reject when no issuer is a prefix of token_url
potential_consequence: Discovery returns a different IdP's endpoints; configured clientId unknown there, auth fails at runtime

trigger_condition: Operator writes the natural scalar form `authorizationServer: https://...` instead of a list
guard_snippet: BeforeValidator wrapping a bare str into [str], or drop only the bad field, not the entry
potential_consequence: Whole server vanishes from the catalog; clients lose it silently, only a backend log

trigger_condition: Every existing catalog entry now serves `"authorizationServer": null` inside the oauth object
guard_snippet: @router.get(..., response_model_exclude_none=True) or omit the key entirely when it is None
potential_consequence: Strict client schemas (optional-but-not-nullable) reject the oauth block; whole catalog fails to parse

trigger_condition: Example ships authorizationServer alongside authorizationUrl carrying kc_idp_hint and prompt
guard_snippet: Warn at load when authorization_server is set and authorization_url has a query string
potential_consequence: Operators copy the example and silently lose federated IdP routing and forced re-login
